title: Faraday beats GPT-5.5 at replicating research, but 153 runs produced zero new methods
description:
Inherent Labs' 27B Faraday agent outperformed Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 at reproducing published research results on Inherent's Replica benchmark, while Prime Intellect's 153 autonomous runs across 18 frontier models found every successful approach was a recombination of existing methods. These two results together mark the honest floor of autonomous AI research: extraordinary speed at reassembling known science, with genuine origination still ahead. That recombination capability alone could reshape how science validates itself, turning replication from a chronically underfunded bottleneck into something a trained system handles across hundreds of papers, freeing human researchers for the harder questions that still require a fundamentally new idea.
